title: ID0468037-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197004] HMI issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Customer is experiencing a failure with the HMI at the Shell Recharge l Posto Saci station (Y2 R4 313020197004) - LOC, SP-330, SN - KM 84 - Macuco, Valinhos - SP, 13273-609. As you can see in the attached video, the HMI touchscreen is frozen. Customer has already performed a reset on the station, but the error persists.
Solution: Replace HMI
